name: DeliveryReceipt
description: Represents a delivery, engagement, or failure event emitted by a communications provider for a previously sent message across any channel.

id.description: Unique identifier of the delivery receipt event.

message_id.description: Identifier of the message this receipt refers to.

channel.description: Delivery channel for the original message.

event.description: Event type reported by the provider.

recipient.description: Recipient address that received (or failed to receive) the message.

occurred_at.description: Timestamp when the provider observed the event.

error.description: Error information when the event indicates a failure.

user_agent.description: User agent reported with an engagement event such as an email open or click.
user_agent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 18_2 like Mac OS X)

ip_address.description: IP address associated with an engagement event.

url.description: URL associated with a click event.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata propagated from the original send (campaign id, tenant id, etc.).
